page_title: MCI 2-1 BRE | Manchester City v Brentford 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Savinho leaves the pitch and Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) comes on.

90+2' That was close by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 7:4.
86' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
84' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) has come on for Mikkel Damsgaard.
84' Here is a change. John Stones is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Dias (Manchester City).
84' Substitution. Jack Grealish did his best and is replaced by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
82' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) was probably a bit loose with his words to Darren Bond, who decides to show him a yellow.
81' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
79' Yellow card. John Stones (Manchester City) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

78' The opposition back off Savinho (Manchester City) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

76' Savinho (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Mark Flekken anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
75' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
73' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) replaces Kristoffer Ajer.
72' It's time for a substitution. Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) comes on in place of Vitaly Janelt.

72' That was close by Kyle Walker (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
72' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) works the corner short.

72' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
71' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
71' Savinho (Manchester City) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

71' Rodri (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Savinho (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.

69' Superb touch by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save! The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
69' Savinho (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

68' A sweet pass finds Jack Grealish (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Mark Flekken is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' Good clearance! Jack Grealish (Manchester City) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.

66' A precise low pass is received by Savinho (Manchester City), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
65' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared by the defence.

65' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
63' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
60' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
57' Savinho (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
55' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' The ball possession is 52:48.
50' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Savinho (Manchester City) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Darren Bond pulls out a yellow card.
46' The game is over for Rico Lewis (Manchester City). Josko Gvardiol comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Pep Guardiola probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City). He is replaced by Rodri.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' A cross from Savinho (Manchester City) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45+5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brentford was in an offside position.
45+2' Great save! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Ederson.
45+1' Problems for Thomas Frank as Yoane Wissa is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Kevin Schade (Brentford) replaces him.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee Darren Bond and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
41' Savinho (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
41' Savinho (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.

39' A through ball from Savinho (Manchester City) fails to reach Erling Haaland as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Erling Haaland could have got into a promising position.
37' The ball is laid off to Savinho (Manchester City) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the left side of the goal and forces Mark Flekken to make a decent save.
35' Savinho (Manchester City) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
35' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner.
34' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
32' 2 - 1 Goal! Ederson finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 2:1.
30' A corner kick by Brentford is thwarted by the well prepared Ederson (Manchester City).

29' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) attempts to convert a cross into goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the top left corner is denied by a decent save from Ederson. The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

27' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
27' A terrific attempt by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
25' Savinho (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

19' 1 - 1 Wonderful movement! Kevin De Bruyne is in a good position inside the box but decides to pass the ball to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who keeps his cool and blasts the ball inside the left post. What a finish that is – 1:1.
18' The game is interrupted as Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is flagged offside.
17' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
17' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
16' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) commits a foul and Darren Bond immediately signals a free kick.
15' The corner from Savinho (Manchester City) is intercepted by the defence.
15' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

13' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
13' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
13' A cross into the box from Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is cleared. Manchester City have a corner.
12' Savinho (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

10' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Ederson makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
9' Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford). Brentford win a corner.
8' Ederson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Yoane Wissa (Brentford) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
1' 0 - 1 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 0:1.
1' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Darren Bond.
